newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwanda attacks EU arms embargo suggestion.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda attacks EU arms embargo suggestion.

text.p: A suggestion at a European Union foreign ministers' meeting for a possible arms embargo in Africa's Great Lakes region drew an angry protest on Wednesday from Rwanda which said it was being targeted.
"The proposed European Union arms embargo is a cynical ploy aimed against the people of Rwanda," an official statement from Rwanda's presidency said.
"Whoever is behind the European Union move is clearly targeting Rwanda, and we strongly condemn this abuse of international conventions," said the statement sent to Reuters in Nairobi.
The worsening conflict in eastern Zaire and instability in the surrounding Great Lakes region, was discussed again by EU foreign ministers last Monday.
The ministers directed their political committee to "consider the advisability and geographical extent of a regional embargo on supplies of weapons and military equipment".
The Rwandan statement said Burundi and Zaire were already under sanctions of one type or another and therefore Rwanda was clearly the target.
"The government of Rwanda is not involved in the conflicts in the Great Lakes region," the Rwandan statement said.
Repeated allegations by Zaire that Rwandan and Ugandan troops have fought alongside rebels in eastern Zaire led to the United States warning Rwanda and Uganda not to get militarily involved.

Rwanda is not under an international arms embargo but its most recent publicly announced arms deal, with South Africa, was suspended by Pretoria last November when African states said it would fuel the conflict. REUTER
